summary: LectureMind AI chunking pipeline backend tests: added 13 new tests in test_chunking.py covering audio_chunker (format_timestamp, get_duration_seconds, split_into_chunks+cleanup), LectureDB defaults, normalize_mime, single-shot pipeline (short audio), chunked pipeline (1900s ffmpeg-synthesized mp3 → 4 chunks), error-path cleanup, and POST /api/lectures response-shape regression. All 72/72 tests pass (13 new + 37 MVP + 22 P1). Gemini fully mocked via FakeAI; real ffmpeg used to generate test audio.

minor.issue: Pre-existing latent bug: Motor client singleton (core.db._client) is cached across asyncio.run() calls, so once any test exits its loop, subsequent tests in OTHER files relying on the cached client crash with RuntimeError: Event loop is closed. Was masked by test ordering until test_chunking.py landed alphabetically first. Worked around by adding a conftest.py autouse fixture that resets core_db._client around every test. Recommend moving the reset into core.db.get_db() itself (lazy + per-loop) so production code is also safer in async contexts that span multiple loops.

Optional (already raised in iter1/2): RBAC on quiz attempts, 503 vs 500 on AI cold paths, timezone-aware streaks — still pending.

rca of the issue: The 4 RuntimeError: Event loop is closed failures observed during the first combined run were caused by core/db.py caching the Motor AsyncIOMotorClient in a module-level singleton (_client). When test_chunking.py runs first and exits its asyncio.run() loop, the cached client retains a reference to that now-closed loop; the next file (test_lecturemind_api.py) then calls asyncio.run(seed()) which tries to schedule work on the dead loop via Motor's executor and blows up. Reproduction: pytest tests/test_chunking.py tests/test_lecturemind_api.py::TestQuizScoring. Mitigation applied: tests/conftest.py autouse fixture nullifies core_db._client before and after every test, forcing get_db() to lazily rebuild on the current loop. Longer-term fix belongs in core/db.py (per-loop client keying).
